name: Anomalous
source:
Two anomalous entities contained within a secret facility are in tension. Follow the Robot as she struggles to obey the Manager's new orders: handling the Flesh, a stubborn and unserious shape-shifting monster of gore.

[From [url=https://paletteheart.itch.io/anomalous]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
秘密设施内的两个异常实体关系紧张。跟随机器人，她努力遵守经理的新命令：处理肉体，一个顽固而不严肃的变形血腥怪物。

[来自[url=https://paletteheart.itch.io/anomalous]itch.io[/url]]
